extraction.Name: Annie Desersa
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 4, 1918, by Walcott & Walcott
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Valentine State Bank for $550; conveyed by deed to W. H. Tackett for $2000 on June 18, 1918
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612676 issued; Northeast quarter of section 12, township 38, range 27; receipt for patent signed by allottee but not dated; Annie Desersa mortgaged the land to the Valentine State Bank for $550 on May 31, 1918; allotment number also referenced as 3028 at top of document
